title: When the Smile Falls
author: Wren Eastwick
blurb: Ivo Ravensworth, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
